verbatim_snippet: "(Earlier) The team was great, and my first two courses didn't even have a contract. They did all the production, helped me set up my first course, and it even became a best-seller. Then they started to downgrade these royalties. Their last proposal was 5% (royalties) for a new course, which I refused."
